rca_of_issue: React onChange not firing: In production Next.js builds, Playwright's page.fill() may not trigger React 19's new event handling. React 19 uses a different synthetic event reconciliation. The button disabled={loading || !email} checks React state (not DOM input value), so even though DOM shows testuser@mailinator.com, React state email='' keeps button disabled. Fix for testing: add a data-testid on the form and use page.evaluate to call React's dispatchEvent with proper event object, or add an uncontrolled ref to the input.
